description: Policies sold and annual premium per writing agent, closed today. Reads HubSpot deals in the Sold stage (closed won), grouped by writing agent.

args.sql: SELECT hubspot_owner_id, writing_agent_name, COUNT(*), SUM(annual_premium_amount) FROM DEAL WHERE dealstage = 'closedwon' AND closedate >= {{d_start}} AND writing_agent_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY hubspot_owner_id, writing_agent_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 100

title: Daily sales by agent
